fields.description: Everly Place is Ellington’s 209-home apartment project in Meydan Horizon, MBR City, with lagoon-side leisure spaces and one- to three-bedroom layouts, including study options.

reviewCoverage.identity: Exact own project body, dated June 2026 launch and Everly-labelled documents establish the apartment project and 209 homes; no global navigation facts imported.
reviewCoverage.location: Developer launch places Everly within Meydan Horizon, MBR City. Portal taxonomy Ras Al Khor Industrial 1 is recorded as an alternative, not substituted for the marketing community.
reviewCoverage.residences: One- and two-bedroom apartments and one-/two-/three-bedroom with study supported by main page, brief and actual plans. Five retail drawings remain separate from residential mix.
reviewCoverage.areas: 58-page brief and 22-page plans text-read. All eleven residential numerical panels on plans pages 6–16 visually checked; brief summary page 10 and actual first drawing reviewed. Study size and 2-bedroom B discrepancies disclosed.
reviewCoverage.amenities: Own body and project microsite list bowling, club lounge, fitness, sauna, play and outdoor leisure. Planned features, not claims of current operation.
reviewCoverage.pricing: No primary current starting price found. Exact Property Finder project FAQ advertises AED 1940000; retained as portal reference, not developer inventory.
reviewCoverage.payment: Actual one-page primary schedule visually read and corroborated on own microsite:20+10+10+six5+30=100. Fees not folded into purchase instalments.
reviewCoverage.handover: Primary reviewed documents have no calendar date. Property Finder data says December 2030 but its FAQ says 2031. No selection between those estimates; headline null.
reviewCoverage.documents: 42-page own design brochure, 58-page official brief,22-page floorplan pack and one-page payment document retrieved via public official links without forms. Own gallery has October 2026 entry; no certificate/status inference.

overview: Lagoon-facing apartments are arranged around a low-rise residential tower and a separate amenities pavilion, with a mix of compact homes and study layouts.
research.locationNote: Meydan Horizon within Mohammed Bin Rashid City, Dubai. Property Finder files it under Ras Al Khor Industrial 1; these are different location labels, not interchangeable plot confirmations.
research.priceNote: Property Finder advertises AED 1.94 million. This is not a verified current developer quotation or confirmation that a particular apartment is available.
research.paymentNote: The primary schedule totals 100%:70% before completion,30% on completion. Confirm reservation-relative dates, milestones and all fees for the chosen apartment.
research.handoverNote: No calendar handover date was found in the reviewed primary documents. Property Finder lists December 2030 while its FAQ refers to 2031; neither is adopted as a confirmed completion date.

facts.label: Building and parking
facts.value: G+2 podiums+10 residential floors+roof. One parking space for 1-/2-bedroom homes; two for 3-bedroom homes.

facts.label: Service charge reference
facts.value: Brief: anticipated AED 16/ft²; billing basis and final approved budget require confirmation.

facts.label: Source differences
facts.value: Brief study summary 977–982 ft² conflicts with its 997.71 drawing. Two-bedroom B is 1,284.08 in brief versus 1,284.03 in plans. Printed plan totals retained, including 0.01 rounding differences.

facts.label: Construction information
facts.value: Own gallery includes October 2026 photographs; a gallery date is not proof of completion.

unresolved: Current stock, signed price, furnishing and final service-charge budget require a dated selected-unit quotation.
Primary calendar completion is unavailable; secondary guide contradicts itself. Obtain the contractual programme.
Study size summary and individual drawings require developer reconciliation before purchase.
